meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Guides a refactor, cleanup, or restructure with the right decomposition. Use when the user asks to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将混乱代码改造成清晰结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 代码越来越乱,想在不改功能的前提下变得清晰好维护。
copy.tagline_en: Restructure messy code into a clear, maintainable design.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase is messy and you want to clean it up without changing behavior.

howto.what: 当用户要求重构代码时，Claude 会先确认目标和范围，再分析整个代码库，找出所有受影响的文件和测试。随后制定分步计划，每改一步就运行测试验证没弄坏，最后跑完整测试并总结改动。
howto.when: 当用户提出重构、简化、提取等代码整理请求时触发；若目标模糊（如只说“改进代码”），Claude 会先追问具体要改善什么。

say.text: 把 AuthService 类拆成更小的几个类，重构一下
say.note: Claude 先确认范围再分析调用关系

say.text: 简化 src/utils.ts，只改这一个文件，保守策略
say.note: 按 safe 模式单文件重构并逐步验证

say.text: 把这段重复逻辑提取成公共函数，并更新所有调用处
say.note: 会先找引用和测试再开始

howto.what_en: When asked to refactor code, Claude confirms the goal, maps the codebase, finds affected files/tests, makes a plan, changes code step by step, runs tests after each step, then runs the full suite and summarizes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to refactor, clean up, or restructure code; if the goal is vague, Claude asks for specifics first.

say_en.text: Refactor AuthService by splitting it into smaller classes
say_en.note: It confirms the scope and maps dependencies first

say_en.text: Simplify src/utils.ts — only this file, conservative strategy
say_en.note: Runs step-by-step verification with minimal risk

say_en.text: Extract this duplicated logic into a shared function and update all call sites
say_en.note: Finds references and tests before starting
